summary: preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui-cypress@2.1.3 declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), chmod 0755's the extracted binary, and uses execFileSync to run the bundled sibling `math_init.js` under Bun. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated: setup.mjs uses hex-named identifiers (`_0x...`) with control-flow flattening, and math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line bundle with string-array rotation (`WV8StW` array-shuffle), a mixed numeric/string constant table (`n7gIxM`), and a decoder function (`hc1jfK9`) with a shuffled charset alphabet — typical obfuscator.io output. The package's advertised surface is trivial Cypress selector constants (`main:./dist/index.js` re-exports from `./utils/chat-ui-selectors`), which does not require a second-language runtime or a 727KB obfuscated payload at install time. Using an alternate downloaded runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle from a lifecycle hook evades scanners that inspect only Node-resolved code. Package name and CHANGELOG references to `github.com/servicetitan/titan-chatbot-client` are consistent with impersonation of a ServiceTitan internal package targeting that organization's consumers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
